title: Veil
summary: Real-time secret redaction for streamers: API keys, tokens, wallets and seed phrases never make it to the stream.
challenge: Keep a live API key, wallet address or seed phrase out of the stream while you still see it locally — and do it without adding stream delay.
decisions: Blur rectangles over exact screen regions: the local socket carries coordinates and rule ids, never secret text
Detect in the editor where the text is exact, and fall back to OCR only for windows with no detector
Redact inside the OBS encode pipeline rather than switching the whole scene
Detection rules adapted from gitleaks, seed phrases from the BIP-39 wordlist

evidence.label: Detectors
evidence.value: Keys, tokens, JWTs, seed phrases, cards

ownership: Designed and built the detection layer and the Windows client end to end.
